newsitem.title: FINLAND: KONECRANES SETS MANAGEMENT OPTION PLAN.
newsitem.headline: KONECRANES SETS MANAGEMENT OPTION PLAN.

text.p: Finnish cranes maker KCI Konecranes International Oy said on Wednesday it will launch a share option plan for its management, pending approval from the annual general meeting.
"Under the plan, the group's middle management will hold warrants to purchase an aggregate of 300,000 ordinary shares in KCI Konecranes at 155 markka per share," Konecranes said in a statement.
The share option plan is constructed as an issue of bonds with warrants, it said.
The bonds will not pay interest and they will be fully redeemed on April 1, 2003.
